# FQHESphereUnnormalizeState

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereUnnormalizeState`

Manual: [FQHESphereUnnormalizeState (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/FQHESphereUnnormalizeState.md)

```text
FQHESphereUnnormalizeState, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereUnnormalizeState [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -i, --input-state : file that describes states to fuse
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis
    --reference-file : use a file as the definition of the reference state of the output state
    --p-truncated : use a p-truncated basis instead of the full n-body basis
    --p-truncation : p-truncation for the p-truncated basis (if --p-truncated is used) (default value = 0)
    --boson-truncation : maximum occupation for a given orbital for the p-truncated basis (default value = 1)
    --symmetrized-basis : use Lz <-> -Lz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-lz=0)
    --tzZ3symmetrized-basis : use fully symmetrized version of the basis on CP2 (only valid if total tz=0, y = 0, override detection from input vector name)
    --huge-basis : use huge Hilbert space support
    --memory : maximum memory (in MBytes) that can allocated for precalculations when using huge mode (default value = 100)
    --normalization : indicates which component should be set to one (default value = 0)
    --symmetry-factor : do not remove(add) the symmetry factor when (un)normalizing
    --conformal-limit : indicate that the input state is in the conformal limit basis instead of the unnormalized basis

output options:
    -o, --output-file : name of the unnormalized vector that will be generated
    -t, --txt-output : output the vector into a text file
    --txt-separatespin : for the text output, use the sign convention which separates spins
    --normalize : normalize the state instead of unnormalizing
    --noglobal-normalization : when normalizing, just restoire the geometry/occupation factors without enforcing the full state to be normalized to one
    --hide-component : in the text output, hide state components whose absolute value is lower than a given error (0 if all components have to be shown (default value = 0)
    --hide-inputcomponent : in the text output, hide state components whose absolute value is lower than a given error in the original normalized state (0 if all components have to be shown (default value = 0)

precalculation options:
    --load-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the indicated file (only available for the Haldane basis)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
